Librogame.title: Forty Minutes to Midnight!
Librogame.author: Roberto «Fox» Marcarini

Changes.Change: Adapted for this app: the structure, the rules and parts of the text were changed or removed to work with its engine
Translated into English from the original Italian
Added sounds and background music, delivered together with the book

Librogame.ContentWarnings: Ghosts, spectres and a death of the protagonist told without detail. Ghost-story fright, nothing more.
Librogame.Blurb:
You are a famous Ghost Hunter, and at Baldwin Manor something has gone wrong: someone has struck you on the head. You come round in a disused room, with your Magic Candle almost spent and a Grandfather Clock showing 23:20.
At midnight the spirits will be at their strongest. Every room burns one Flame of your Candle, and when you have crossed off five, the forces of the Manor will take you.

Page.Text:
You are a famous Ghost Hunter and, armed with your wide-brimmed hat and your trusty Magic Candle, you ventured into Baldwin Manor, a notorious haunted house... but something went wrong! While you were exploring those crumbling walls, you were struck on the head and lost consciousness. Now, as you slowly come round, you realise that your trusty Candle is almost spent and that it is probably nearly midnight: the hour when spirit activity will be at its peak!
You must escape from Baldwin Manor as soon as possible, or you may not be able to withstand the evil forces that lurk here.
Beware: if the Flames crossed off reach 5, the baleful powers of Baldwin Manor will seize you!
You get up, your head still aching from the nasty blow, and, Candle in hand, you light up your surroundings: the light flickers, a sign that spirits and restless dead are near. You realise you are in a long-disused room, with only one object worth noting: a large Grandfather Clock, strangely still working. It shows 23:20: you have only 40 minutes to escape, if the time is right! Behind you, a peeling Old Door leads out of the room.

Choice.text: Open the Old Door and leave the room

Page.Text: You can choose to pass under a great arch into the Drawing Room, or go into what looks like a Small Study.

Choice.text: Pass under the great arch, into the Drawing Room

Page.Text: Once you are over the threshold, the door slams violently shut behind you: all you hear is the lock's mechanism clicking over several times, as if a ghostly key had locked it. So you find yourself walking down a long corridor; the floor creaks ominously under your feet and you fear you may fall through at any moment. When at last you reach the end of the corridor, you find yourself at a fork.

You run flat out through the cellars, with only your Candle faintly lighting the way. Behind you, the spectre is breathing down your neck. You reach a fork and have little time to think: which way do you turn?

You almost get lost as you finish exploring the Cellar's many corridors, until you come to a large hole in one of the brick walls: with your Candle you light up a small cave, wet with water and lit by a faint glow from above. You decide to go in and waste no more time.

The Drawing Room has certainly seen better days: the few pieces of furniture are covered with dusty old sheets, and that Old Painting hanging over the fireplace is truly unsettling. Creaking stairs seem to lead down to a Cellar and who knows what dangers, but luckily your light falls on a possible way out: the Main Door!
The Main Door is shut by a fiendishly complicated mechanical lock that only the right key can open.

Choice.text: Go back to the Drawing Room

Page.Text: You enter the Small Study as the flame of your Candle crackles faintly. You spend a few minutes rummaging through the papers, scrolls and dusty old books that fill the study's shelves in no order at all, finding nothing. Just before you give up, you spot a crumpled sheet of paper near the foot of the desk and decide to pick it up and read it: a number, «333», is written on it in red ink. While you are wondering whether it means anything, an unnatural wind sucks you out of the Small Study and hurls you into the Drawing Room, where you arrive tumbling head over heels.
CLICK! The combination is correct and the safe swings open before your eyes. Inside there is only one object: a Skull Key. Time is running out. Where do you want to go now?

The painting shows an old man with a surly look. He seems to watch you with his malevolent eyes. The canvas, slightly moth-eaten, unexpectedly shows you that something is hidden behind the Old Painting.

Choice.text: Go back to the Drawing Room

Page.Text: You go very carefully down the stairs to the cellar when, behind you, right in the Drawing Room you came from, you notice a tall, black, skeletal figure watching you. Its face looks like the man in the painting... were it not for the red eye sockets and the floating robes made of shadow. «I'm hungry, hunter...» it says in a hoarse voice, then it hurls itself down the stairs like a bird of prey. What do you do?

Choice.text: Pour out the Candle's power (2 Flames)

Page.Text: The shadows grow heavy as the light of your Candle goes out completely. Around you there is only cold, and the voices of restless souls hungry for your warmth. In the distance, the Grandfather Clock strikes midnight. Your adventure at Baldwin Manor ends here...
Unfortunately, the choice you make is the wrong one. Shortly after turning, you find yourself facing a dead end. Behind you, all you hear is the growl of the spectre...
You carefully take down the painting, laying it gently on the floor, and reveal what looks like a small wall safe locked by a 3-digit mechanical combination.

Choice.ask: The safe has a 3-digit combination. Add the three numbers together: what do you get?

Choice.text: Go back to the Drawing Room

Page.Text: You focus the powers of your Candle, striking the Spectre with a beam of light, and it evaporates before you. The blast that follows knocks you and most of the Cellar's old furniture head over heels, stairs included, which snap with a loud CRACK! For now the danger is over, but your Candle is almost exhausted... There is nothing left to do but carry on exploring the Cellar.

You keep running, but behind you the spectre won't give up. You are about to collapse from exhaustion and terror when you leap through a large hole in the brick wall and find yourself with your feet in the water of a small natural cave, lit by moonlight coming from above you. The spectre has stopped at the cave entrance and howls with rage: perhaps it cannot come in?

As soon as you get close, the hands on the dial seem to go mad and the very shadows come alive around you, as if they wanted to grab you. As you flee the room, a voice from the Grandfather Clock calls to you, making your blood run cold: «...I await you in the cellar, hunter: come to me, if you have the courage to face me!».

You search the Cave and find a long rope coming down from a hole in the ceiling, and then you understand: you are inside a well lit by the moon! You immediately decide to climb and slowly make your way up towards the surface; a few moments later your Candle goes out completely. When you reach the top, you find yourself in the grounds of the Manor.

You insert the Skull Key and, in a great hurry, turn it in the complicated lock until it clicks. As you draw back the last bolt and get ready to open the heavy door, you hear a muffled, desperate cry behind you: «nooooo...». You just have time to throw yourself out of the doorway as a shadowy claw almost snatches you. You tumble onto the drive of Baldwin Manor and run for several metres before stopping to catch your breath!

You did it! You escaped from Baldwin Manor just before the stroke of Midnight. As you walk away into the heart of the night, you can hear behind you the restless dead wailing from the Manor over their defeat! Great work, Ghost Hunter!
